about_the_game:
Inspired by a true experience

You wake up in a damp hospital room in the winter of 1992 with a splitting headache. The first thing you find is your own death certificate. Hospital rooms are filled with terrible smells and deformed people.

You'll never forget what you witness as you descend deeper

The hospital's roof is 6 meters underground. The only way out is to learn the truth. The only way to learn the truth is to reach the negative fourth floor.

Simple choices have major consequences

A simple decision you make will determine whether Emily Halloway survives. But to understand the consequences of your decision and, most importantly, who you are, you'll need to return to where you started. Because you know... Everything ends where it begins.

content_descriptors.notes: This horror game contains psychological thriller elements, violence, and disturbing content. The game features blood, deformed creatures, and medical experiment scenes. Dark atmosphere, jumpscares, and horror elements are present. The game explores themes of memory loss and identity crisis as psychological trauma themes.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 Mojave or higher
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 2.3 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU, 2 GB VRAM (Intel Iris Pro 5200 or better)
  • Storage: 12288 MB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS compatible sound card
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or higher
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 2.3 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU, 4 GB VRAM (AMD Radeon Pro or better)
  • Storage: 12288 MB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS compatible sound card

short_description: To escape from a hospital whose roof is underground, you must descend to the deepest level. At every step, you need to endure witnessing the results of horrific experiments. And rest assured, you will never predict the end of the story.

*languages with full audio support
